steps.do: Greet the customer politely. If they have not already said, ask which credit card they want to refer people to and what terms they understand apply: the bonus amount, the qualifying spend, and the number of days after the referred person's account opening allowed to reach it. Handle each card the customer brings up on its own, running find_program through give_link_tool for each one.
steps.if: the customer asks for a credit card referral link or about a card's referral offer

basis.clause: ask the customer's understanding of the terms
basis.quote: Verify the customer’s understanding of referral terms. If the customer cites terms that do not match any documented program, clarify the discrepancy.
The referred friend must spend at least $1,500 within 90 days of account opening to qualify you for the bonus.

basis.clause: each card checked on its own
basis.quote: Each credit card type has its own referral bonus and eligibility requirements that are not detailed here.
Be polite and professional

steps.do: Search the knowledge base for the named card's own referral program document (for example KB_search_bm25 '<card name> referral program', or grep -il 'referral' on that card's documents) and read it in full. Referral program documents exist for: EcoCard, Silver Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Business Bronze Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card, Business Platinum Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card. None were found for Crypto-Cash Back, Bronze Rewards Card, Gold Rewards Card or Diamond Elite Card.

args.query: the card name from ask_card_terms plus 'referral program'

steps.if: the customer has named a card
steps.quote: Search the knowledge base to confirm the specific card has a documented referral program.

steps.do: Get the current time. Use it for the program end-date check and for the 7 days that end at this current time (the rolling 7-day window).

basis.quote: A rolling 7-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.
If you need the current time, always use the get_current_time() tool.

steps.do: Explain that you could not find a documented referral program for this card, so you can't provide a referral link for it. Do not give the get_referral_link tool and do not transfer. If the customer then asks about a different card, run find_program and the checks after it for that card.

If the search again finds nothing, tell the customer clearly that you searched and cannot find or verify this program, so no referral link can be provided. Give no tool and do not transfer.

steps.do: From get_referrals, count the referral bonuses (status COMPLETE) across all credit card types whose timestamps fall in the period that starts exactly 7 days before the current time from get_time and ends at that current time. If there are 2 or more, explain that a new referral would be denied automatically, and that the customer should wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap. Give no link tool and do not transfer. If any records show REJECTED, review the existing activity before advising, and do not retry immediately.
steps.if: get_referrals returned the customer's referral records

basis.clause: at most 2 bonuses per rolling 7 days; the third is denied
basis.quote: Weekly limit: Customers can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window; the third and subsequent referrals in that window are automatically denied.
This limit applies across all credit card types; referrals from different cards still count toward the same weekly cap.
A rolling 7-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.
COMPLETE — the referred person has successfully opened a new account and met the criteria to get the referral bonus

basis.clause: 2 completed in the past week: further ones don't qualify
basis.quote: so if you've already had 2 referrals complete in the past week, any additional referrals during that time won't qualify for a bonus.

REJECTED: Do not retry immediately; review the user’s existing referral activity before advising next steps.

done_when: For each card the customer asked about, one of two outcomes holds. (a) The agent explained why no link can be given: no documented program (searched again if the customer insisted), program closed, claimed terms incorrect (with the documented terms stated), or the weekly cap reached. No tool was given, no document was requested, and there was no transfer. (b) The customer was verified and logged, received get_referral_link, ran it with their own user ID and the exact card name, and heard the documented terms restated.
